claims.claim: Training should stop when a red-flag symptom is present.
claims.limitations: Not a diagnosis; appropriate medical evaluation remains necessary.

claims.claim: Acute severe sleep restriction can impair performance and recovery.
Exercise selection and loading should be modified when pain is high or worsening.
claims.limitations: Pain severity alone does not identify tissue damage.

claims.claim: Accumulated fatigue can reduce performance and increase the need for load management.
claims.limitations: No single fatigue marker is definitive.

claims.claim: Temporary reductions in training load can restore performance when fatigue exceeds adaptive capacity.
claims.limitations: Optimal timing and magnitude are individual.

claims.claim: Autoregulation using readiness and performance feedback can guide daily load adjustments.
Simpler plans may improve adherence when schedule capacity or compliance is low.
Progression should be based on successful performance rather than automatic load increases alone.
